concerns: price below all major moving averages
technical.summary: Weak bearish setup with isolated bullish technicals (Williams %R rising, supertrend) insufficient to offset pervasive downtrend structure, negative volume signals, and three black crows pattern.

fundamental.summary: DRI shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 35 days.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (10/10) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional activity and absent news sentiment provide no confirmation.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (405.68), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and macro_score of -4 create severely unfavourable conditions; earnings in 35 days adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme fear sentiment (10/10) and Williams %R rising from oversold create contrarian opportunity with support at 101.84 providing defined risk floor.
debate.key_bear_argument: Pervasive downtrend structure (price below all major MAs, three black crows, negative MACD/CMF, Ichimoku below cloud), VIX crisis (405.68), unfavourable macro (-4 score), and zero institutional/insider conviction make this a value trap, not a reversal.

decision.entry_rationale: Extreme fear sentiment (10/10) creates theoretical contrarian opportunity, but this is overwhelmed by pervasive downtrend structure, VIX crisis conditions, and zero institutional/insider conviction signals.
decision.primary_risk: VIX crisis (405.68) and macro deterioration (-4 score) create systemic risk that overshadows isolated technical bounces; earnings in 35 days add event risk to already fragile setup.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — technical, fundamental, and risk agents all align on weakness; only sentiment offers contrarian signal but lacks confirmation
